record.oneLiner: Help Scout is a customer support platform featuring robust REST APIs (Inbox API and Docs API) utilizing OAuth 2.0 and API keys with a generous self-serve free tier.
record.verdictReason: Help Scout provides fully documented REST APIs with self-serve credential creation on free accounts and existing community MCP support.
